duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ، وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the exalted throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the seed and the date stone, Revealer of the Tawrah, the Injeel and the Furqan, I take refuge in You from the evil of all things You shall seize by the forelock (i.e. You have total mastery over). O Allah, You are The First so there is nothing before You and You are The Last so there is nothing after You.You are Aththahir so there is nothing above You and You are Al-Batin so there is nothing closer than You.Settle our debt for us and spare us from poverty.)(Tawrah: The book revealed to Moosa u.)(Injeel: The book revealed to Easa u.)(Furqan: One of the many names of the Quran, means: The Criterion which distinguishes between truth and falsehood.)(Aththahir: Indicates the greatness of His attributes and the insignificance of every single creation in respect to His greatness and Highness, for He is above all of His creation as regards His essence and attributes.)(Al-Batin: Indicates His awareness and knowledge of all secrets, of that which is in the hearts and the most intimate of things just as it indicates His closeness and nearness to all in a manner which befits His majesty.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sabAA, warabbal-AAarshil-AAatheem, rabbana warabba kulli shay/, faliqal-habbi wannawa, wamunazzilat-tawra, wal-injeel, walfurqan, aAAoothu bika min sharri kulli shayin anta akhithun binasiyatih. Allahumma antal-awwal, falaysa qablaka shay/, wa-antal-akhir, falaysa baAAdaka shay/, wa-antath-thahir falaysa fawqaka shay/, waantal-batin, falaysa doonaka shay/, iqdi AAannad-dayna wa-aghnina minal-faqr.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Stirring in the night
duas.arabic: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزيزُ الْغَفَّارُ)).
duas.translation: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, The One, AL-Qahhar.Lord of the heavens and the Earth and all between them, The Exalted in Might, The Oft-Forgiving.)(AL-Qahhar:The One Who has subdued all of creation and Whom all of creation are subservient to.  All movements occur by His will.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (La ilaha illal-lahul-wahidul-qahhar, rabbus-samawati wama baynahuma, alAAazeezul-ghaffar.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Invocation when putting on new clothes
duas.arabic: ( اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ).
duas.translation: (O Allah, for You is all praise, You have clothed me with it (i.e. the garment), I ask You for the good of it and the good for which it was made, and I seek refuge with You from the evil of it and the evil for which it was made.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtaneeh, as-aluka min khayrihi wakhayri ma suniAAa lah, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharrihi washarri ma suniAAa lah.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: আবূ দাউদ, নং ৪০২০; তিরমিযী, নং ১৭৬৭; বাগভী, ১২/৪০; দেখুন, মুখতাসারুশ শামাইল লিল আলবানী, পৃ. ৪৭।

duas.title: Afraid to sleep or feeling lonely
duas.arabic: ((أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّياطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ)).
duas.translation: (I take refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, and from the evil of His servants, and from the madness and appearance of devils.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammat min ghadabih,waAAiqabih, washarri AAibadih, wamin hamazatish-shayateen, wa-an yahduroon.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: আবূ দাঊদ ৪/১২, নং ৩৮৯৩; তিরমিযী, নং ৩৫২৮। আরও দেখুন, সহীহুত তিরমিযী ৩/১৭১

duas.title: After a bad dream
duas.arabic: ((يَنْفُثُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ)) (ثلاثاً).
duas.translation: [((Spit on your left three times)(Spit: A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle)) - (Seek refuge in Allah from shaytan and the evil of what you saw (Three Times)) - (Do not relate it to anyone) - (Turn and sleep on the opposite side to which you were sleeping on previously.) - (Get up and pray if you so desire.) ]
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: After a bad dream
duas.arabic: ((ويَقُومُ يُصَلِّي إِنْ أَرَادَ ذَلِكَ)).
duas.translation: (Get up and pray if you so desire.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ؛ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلاَ يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، إِنَّهُ لاَ يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ، [وَلاَ يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ]، تَبارَكْتَ رَبَّنا وَتَعَالَيْتَ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, guide me along with those whom You have guided, pardon me along with those whom You have pardoned, be an ally to me along with those whom You are an ally to and bless for me that which You have bestowed.  Protect me from the evil You have decreed for verily You decree and none can decree over You.For surety, he whom you show allegiance to is never abased and he whom You take as an enemy is never honoured and mighty. O our Lord, Blessed and Exalted are You.)(Evil you have decreed: Allah does not create pure evil which does not have any good or contain any benefit, wisdom or mercy at all, nor does He punish anyone without having commited a sin. Something can be good in terms of its creation when viewed in a particular perspective and at the same time be evil when viewed in another way.Allah created the devil and by him, He tests His servants, so there are those who hate the devil, fight him and his way and they stand at enmity towards him and his followers and there are others who are at allegiance with the devil and follow his steps. So evil exists in His creatures by His will and wisdom, not in His actions or act of creating.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahummah-dinee feeman hadayt, waAAafinee feeman AAafayt, watawallanee feeman tawallayt, wabarik lee feema aAAtayt, waqinee sharra ma qadayt, fa-innaka taqdee wala yuqda AAalayk, innahu la yathillu man walayt, [wala yaAAizzu man AAadayt], tabarakta rabbana wataAAalayt.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُــــوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لاَ أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise. You are as You have praised Yourself.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu biridaka min sakhatik, wabimuAAafatika min AAuqoobatik, wa-aAAoothu bika mink, la ohsee thana-an AAalayk, anta kama athnayta AAala nafsik.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نعْبُدُ، وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ، وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَى وَنَحْفِدُ، نَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ، وَنَخْشَى عَذَابَكَ، إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالكَافِرِينَ مُلْحَقٌ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعينُكَ، وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ، وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ، وَلاَ نَكْفُرُكَ، وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ، وَنَخْضَعُ لَكَ، وَنَخْلَعُ مَنْ يَكْفرُكَ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, it is You we worship, and unto You we pray and prostrate, and towards You we hasten and You we serve. We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment, verily Your punishment will fall upon the disbelievers.O Allah, we seek Your aid and ask Your pardon, we praise You with all good and do not disbelieve in You.We believe in You and submit unto You, and we disown and reject those who disbelieve in You.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma iyyaka naAAbud, walaka nusallee wanasjud, wa-ilayka nasAAa wanahfid, narjoo rahmatak, wanakhsha AAathabak, inna AAathabaka bilkafireena mulhaq. Allahumma inna nastaAAeenuk, wanastaghfiruk, wanuthnee AAalaykal- khayr, wala nakfuruk, wanu/minu bik, wanakhdaAAu lak wanakhlaAAu man yakfuruk.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: হাদীসটি বায়হাকী তাঁর ‘আস-সুনানুল কবরা’ গ্রন্থে সংকলন করেছেন এবং তার সনদ বিশুদ্ধ বলেছেন, ২/২১১ আর শাইখ আলবানী ইরওয়াউল গালীল এর ২/১৭০ এ বলেন, ‘এর সনদ বিশুদ্ধ। আর তা উমর রা. থেকে মওকূফ হাদীসে বর্ণিত।

duas.title: What to say immediately following the Witr prayer
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَ المَلِكِ القُدُّوسِ)) ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ والثَّالِثَةُ يَجْهَرُ بها ويَمُدُّ بها صَوتَهُ يقولُ: [رَبِّ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ])).
duas.translation: (How perfect The King, The Holy One is.(three times) on the third time he would raise his voice, elongate it and add: (Lord of the angles and the Rooh (i.e. Jibra-eel).))
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Subhanal-malikil-quddoos.(three times).on the third time he would raise his voice, elongate it and add: (Rabbil-mala-ikati warrooh.))
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Times of worry and grief
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُــــلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلاَءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, my forelock is in Your hand (i.e. You have total mastery over), Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You which You named Yourself with, or revealed in Your Book, or You taught to any of Your creation, or You have preserved in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Quran the life of my heart and the light of my breast, and a departure for my sorrow and a release for my anxiety.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma innee AAabduk, ibnu AAabdik, ibnu amatik, nasiyatee biyadik, madin fiyya hukmuk, AAadlun fiyya qada-ok, as-aluka bikulli ismin huwa lak, sammayta bihi nafsak, aw anzaltahu fee kitabik, aw AAallamtahu ahadan min khalqik awis-ta/tharta bihi fee AAilmil-ghaybi AAindak, an tajAAalal-Qurana rabeeAAa qalbee, wanoora sadree, wajalaa huznee wathahaba hammee.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: আহমাদ ১/৩৯১, নং ৩৭১২ আর শাইখ আলবানী তাঁর সিলসিলাতুল আহাদীসিস সহীহাহ গ্রন্থে ১/৩৩৭ একে সহীহ বলেছেন।

duas.title: Times of worry and grief
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-hammi walhuzn, walAAajzi walkasali walbukhli waljubn, wadalAAid-dayni waghalabatir-rijal.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: বুখারী, ৭/১৫৮, নং ২৮৯৩; আরও দেখুন, বুখারী, (ফাতহুল বারীসহ) ১১/১৭৩; আরও দেখুন যা ৪১.২ নং দুআ এ বর্ণিত হবে।

duas.title: Times of anguish
duas.arabic: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ)).
duas.translation: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah Forbearing.  None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the magnificent throne.  None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the Earth and Lord of the noble throne.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (La ilaha illal-lahul-AAatheemul-haleem, la ilaha illal-lahu rabbul-AAarshil-AAatheem, la ilaha illal-lahu  rabbus-samawati warabbul-ardi warabbul-AAarshil-kareem.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Times of anguish
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me in charge of my affairs even for a blink of an eye and rectify for me all of my affairs.None has the right to be worshipped except You.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma rahmataka arjoo fala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata AAayn, wa-aslih lee sha/nee kullah, la ilaha illa ant.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: আবূ দাউদ, ৪/৩২৪, নং ৫০৯০; আহমাদ ৫/৪২, নং ২০৪৩০। আর শাইখ আলবানী সহীহ আবি দাউদ গ্রন্থে ৩/৯৫৯ এটাকে হাসান হাদীস বলেছেন।

duas.title: Times of anguish
duas.arabic: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّالِمِينَ)).
duas.translation: (None has the right to be worshipped except You.  How perfect You are, verily I was among the wrong-doers.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (La ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu minath-thalimeen.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: সূরা আল আন্মবিয়া - ২১ঃ৮৭

duas.title: Times of anguish
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً)).
duas.translation: (Allah, Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything with Him.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (None has the right to be worshipped except You.  How perfect You are, verily I was among the wrong-doers.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference:
[১] হাইসামী, মাওয়ারিদুয যামআন ৭/৪০০-৪০১
[২] ইবনু হাজার আসকালানী, ফাতহুল বারী ১১/১৪৬-১৪৭

duas.title: Meeting an adversary or a powerful ruler
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِم، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, we place You before them and we take refuge in You from their evil.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma inna najAAaluka fee nuhoorihim wanaAAoothu bika min shuroorihim.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: আবু দাঊদ ২/৮৯, নং ১৫৩৭; আর হাকেম হাদীসটিকে সহীহ বলেছেন এবং ইমাম যাহাবী একে সমর্থন করেছেন ২/১৪২

duas.title: Meeting an adversary or a powerful ruler
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي، وَأَنْتَ نَصِيرِي، بِكَ أَحُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ، وَبِكَ أُقاتِلُ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, You are my supporter and You are my helper, by You I move and by You I attack and by You I battle.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma anta AAadudee, wa-anta naseeree, bika ajoolu wabika asoolu wabika oqatil)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Meeting an adversary or a powerful ruler
duas.arabic: ((حَسْبُنا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ)).
duas.translation: (Allah is sufficient for us, and how fine a trustee (He is).)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Hasbunal-lahu waniAAmal-wakeel.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: সূরা আল ইমরান - ৩ঃ১৭৩

duas.title: Against the oppression of rulers
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلاَئِقِكَ، أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ)).
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne,  be for me a support against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is your patronage and glorious are your praises. There is none worthy of worship but you.
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: Allaahumma rabbas-samaawaatis-sab'i, wa Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adheem, Kun lee jaaran min (here you mention the person's name) wa 'ahzabihi min khalaa'iqika, 'an yafruta 'alayya 'ahadun minhum 'aw yatghaa,'Azza jaaruka, wa jalla thanaa'uka, wa laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta.
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Against the oppression of rulers
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ جَمِيعاً، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ، الْمُمْسِكِ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ أَنْ يَقَعْنَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ، مِنْ شَرِّ عَبْدِكَ فُلاَنٍ، وَجُنُودِهِ وَأَتْبَاعِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ، مِنْ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ، اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ شَرِّهِمْ، جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَعَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ)) (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
duas.translation: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. [I seek refuge in You Allah] from the evil of Your slave [name of the person], and his helpers, his followers and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You. (Recite three times in Arabic)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: Allaahu Akbar, Allaahu 'a'azzu min khalqihi jamee'an, Allaahu 'a'azzu mimmaa 'akhaafu wa 'ahdharu, 'a'oothu billaahil-lathee laa ilaaha illaa huwa, almumsikis-samaawaatis-sab'i 'an yaqa'na 'alaal-'ardhi 'illaa bi'ithnihi, min sharri 'abdika (name of the person) wa junoodihi wa 'atbaa'ihi wa ashyaa'ihi minal-jinni wal'insi, Allaahumma kun lee jaaran min sharrihim, Jalla thanaa'uka wa 'azza aaruka, wa tabaarakasmuka, wa laa ilaaha ghayruka.
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Against an enemy
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اهزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift at reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and convulse them.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma munzilal-kitab, sareeAAal-hisab, ihzimil-ahzab, allahummah-zimhum wazalzilhum.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: When you fear people may harm you
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, protect me from them with what You choose.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahummak-fineehim bima shi/.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Invocations for someone who has put on new clothes
duas.arabic: (تُبْلِي وَيُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى)
duas.translation: (May you wear it out and Allah تعالى replace it (with another).’ The intended meaning: A supplication for long life.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Tublee wayukhliful-lahu taAAala.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: সুনান আবি দাউদ ৪/৪১, হাদীস নং ৪০২০; দেখুন, সহীহ আবি দাউদ ২/৭৬০।

duas.title: Invocations for someone who has put on new clothes
duas.arabic: (اِلْبَسْ جَدِيداً وَعِشْ حَمِيداً وَمُتْ شَهِيداً).
duas.translation: (Wear anew, live commendably and die a shaheed.)(shaheed:One who dies fighting the kuffar in order to make the word of Allah superior or in defense of Islam.  It also has other meanings found in the Sunnah such as: the one who dies defending his life, wealth or family; the woman who passes away due to childbirth; one who drowns…etc.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Ilbas jadeedan waAAish hameedan wamut shaheedan.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: সুনান ইবন মাজাহ ২/১১৭৮, নং ৩৫৫৮; বাগাওয়ী, ১২/৪১ দেখুন, সহীহ ইবন মাজাহ ২/২৭৫।

duas.title: Stricken in your faith
duas.arabic: ((يَقُولُ: ((آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ)).
duas.translation: (He should say: (I have believed in Allah and His Messenger.))
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (He should say: ( Amantu billahi warusulih.))
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Stricken in your faith
duas.arabic: ((يَقْرَأُ قَوْلَهُ تَعَالَى: ﴿هُوَ الْأوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظّاهِرُ وَالْباطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾)).
duas.translation: (He should also recite the following verse: (He is The First and The Last, Aththahir and Al-Batin and He knows well all things.)(ththahir: Indicates the greatness of His attributes and the insignificance of every single creation in respect to His greatness and Highness, for He is above all of His creation as regards His essence and attributes.)(Al-Batin: Indicates His awareness and knowledge of all secrets, of that which is in the hearts and the most intimate of things just as it indicates His closeness and nearness to all in a manner which befits His majesty.))
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (He should also recite the following verse: ( Huwa al-awwalu, waal-akhiru, waalththahiru waalbatinu wahuwa bikulli shayin AAaleem))
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: For the setting of a debt
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكِ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me, as opposed to what is unlawful, and spare me by Your grace, of need of others.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahummak-finee bihalalika AAan haramik, wa-aghninee bifadlika AAamman siwak.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: For the setting of a debt
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being over powered by men.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-hammi walhuzn, walAAajzi walkasal, walbukhl, waljubn, wadalAAid-dayni waghalabatir-rijal)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: বুখারী, ৭/১৫৮, নং ২৮৯৩; আরও দেখুন, বুখারী, (ফাতহুল বারীসহ) ১১/১৭৩; আরও দেখুন যা ৪১.২ নং দুআ এ বর্ণিত হবে।

duas.title: Invocation against the distractions of Satan during the prayer and recitation of the Quran
duas.arabic: ((أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ، وَاتْفُلْ عَلَى يَسَارِكَ (ثلاثاً))).
duas.translation: (othman Ibn Al-AAas  narrated: I said ‘O Messenger of Allah, verily the devil comes between me and my prayer and recitation making me confused’ The Messenger of Allah  replied ‘That is a devil called Khanzab, so if you sense his presence then seek refuge in Allah from him and spit (A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle) on your left side three times.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: When something becomes difficult
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty, if You wish, easy.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma la sahla illa ma jaAAaltahu sahla, wa-anta tajAAalul- hazana in shi'ta sahla.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: সহীহ ইবন হিব্বান ২৪২৭, (মাওয়ারিদ); ইবনুস সুন্নী, নং ৩৫১ আর হাফেয (ইবন হাজার) বলেন, এটি সহীহ হাদীস। তাছাড়া আবদুল কাদের আরনাউত ইমাম নওয়াবীর আযকার গ্রন্থের তাখরীজে পৃ. ১০৬, একে সহীহ বলে মত প্রকাশ করেছেন।

duas.title: After committing a sin
duas.arabic: ((مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُذنِبُ ذَنْباً فَيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ إِلاَّ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ)).
duas.translation: (Any servant who commits a sin and as a result, performs ablution, prays two units of prayer (i.e. two rakAAas) and then seeks Allah’s forgiveness, Allah would forgive him.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Against the Devil and his promptings
duas.arabic: ((الْاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُ)).
duas.translation: Seeking refuge from him.
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Against the Devil and his promptings
duas.arabic: الْأَذَانُ
duas.translation: The Adhaan [call to prayer].
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Against the Devil and his promptings
duas.arabic: ((الْأَذْكَارُ وَقِرَاءَةُ الْقُرْآنِ)).
duas.translation: (Recitation of the Quran and the authentic texts of remembrance and supplications.)(e.g. ‘Do not make your homes like the graveyards, indeed the devils flee from the house in which soorat Al-Baqarah has been read’ related by Muslim 1/539, also supplication and remembrance for the morning & evening, before sleep, when getting up, entering and leaving the toilet, entering and leaving the mosque, the recitation of ayat Al-kursiyy and the last two verses of soorat Al-Baqarah before sleeping, the athan…etc.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: When something you dislike happens
duas.arabic: ((قَدَرُ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ)).
duas.translation: (Allah has decreed and what He wills, He does.)(for verily ‘If’ lets in the work of the devil.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Qaddaral-lah, wama shaa faAAal.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: For new parents
duas.arabic: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ)). وَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ الْمُهَــــــنَّأُ فَيَقُولُ: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً، وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ)).
duas.translation: May Allah bless you with His gift to you and may you (the new parent) give thanks, may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness. The reply of the person being congratulated is to say: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and may Allah reward you well and bestow upon you its like and reward you abundantly
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: Baarakallaahu laka fil-mawhoobi laka, wa shakartal-waahiba, wa balagha 'ashuddahu, wa ruzigta birrahu.  The reply of the person being congratulated is to say: Baarakallahu laka wa baaraka 'alayka, wa jazaakallaahu khayran, wa razaqakallaahu mithlahu, wa 'ajzala thawaabaka.
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Seeking protection for children
duas.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَوِّذُ الحَسَنَ وَالحُسَينَ رضي الله عنهما ((أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ)).
duas.translation: (Ibn AAabbas related that the Messenger of Allah  used to commend Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn to Allah’s protection, saying:(I commend you two to the protection of Allah’s perfect words from every devil, vermin, and every evil eye.))
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Ibn AAabbas related that the Messenger of Allah  used to commend Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn to Allah’s protection, saying:(OAAeethukuma bikalimatil-lahit-tammah, min kulli shaytanin wahammah, wamin kulli AAaynin lammah.))
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Visiting the sick
duas.arabic: ((لاَ بأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ)).
duas.translation: (Never mind, may it (the sickness) be a purification, if Allah wills.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (La ba'sa tahoorun in shaal-lah.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Visiting the sick
duas.arabic: ((أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفيَكَ)) (سبع مرات).
duas.translation: (I ask Allah The Supreme, Lord of the magnificent throne to cure you’.(7times) (he (the sick person) will be cured.))
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Asalul-lahal-AAatheem rabbal-AAarshil-AAatheem an yashfeek (7times).)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: What to say when undressing
duas.arabic: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ).
duas.translation: (In the name of Allah.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Bismil-lah.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: তিরমিযী ২/৫০৫, নং ৬০৬, ও অন্যান্য। আরও দেখুন, ইরওয়াউল গালীল, নং ৫০; সহীহুল জামে‘ ৩/২০৩

duas.title: The reward for visiting the sick
duas.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ((إِذَا عَادَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ مَشَى فِي خِرَافَةِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يَجْلِسَ، فَإِذَا جَلَسَ غَمَرَتْهُ الرَّحْمَةُ، فَإِنْ كَانَ غُدْوَةً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مَسَاءً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ)).
duas.translation: (Ali Ibn Abee Talib  related that he heard the Messenger of Allah  say: ‘If a man calls on his sick Muslim brother, it is as if he walks reaping the fruits of Paradise until he sits, and when he sits he is showered in mercy, and if this was in the morning, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the evening, and if this was in the evening, seventy thousand angles send prayers upon him until the morning.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: For the terminally ill
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الْأَعْلَى)).
duas.translation: ‘O Allaah, forgive me, have mercy upon me and unite me with the highest companions
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee wa-alhiqnee birrafeeqil-aAAla.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: For the terminally ill
duas.arabic: ((جَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ يُدْخِلُ يَدَيْهِ فِي الْمَاءِ فَيَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا وَجْهَهُ، وَيَقُولُ: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ إِنَّ لِلْمَوْتِ سَكَرَاتٍ)).
duas.translation: 'Aa.ishah (radhi-yAllaahu 'anhaa) related that The Prophet (sal-Allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) [during his illness in which he passed away] would dip his hands in water and then he would wipe his face and say: ‘None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, death does indeed contain agony.’
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: 'Aa.ishah (radhi-yAllaahu 'anhaa) related that The Prophet (sal-Allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) [during his illness in which he passed away] would dip his hands in water and then he would wipe his face and say:[La ilaha illal-lah, inna lilmawti lasakarat.] ‘None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, death does indeed contain agony.’
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: For the terminally ill
duas.arabic: ((لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ)).
duas.translation: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise.  None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and there is no might and no power except with Allah.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (La ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar, la ilaha illal-lahu wahdah, la shareeka lah, la ilaha illal-lahu lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, la ilaha illal-lah, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: হাদীসটি ইমাম তিরমিযী সংকলন করেছেন, নং ৩৪৩০; ইবন মাজাহ্‌, নং ৩৭৯৪; আর শাইখ আলবানী একে সহীহ বলেছেন। দেখুন, সহীহুত তিরমিযী ৩/১৫২; সহীহ ইবন মাজাহ ২/৩১৭।

duas.title: What to encourage the dying person to say
duas.arabic: ((مَنْ كَانَ آخِرُ كَلاَمِهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ)).
duas.translation: i.e. those around the sick should instruct and encourage him to say the shahadah. (He whose last words are: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.) will enter Paradise.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: i.e. those around the sick should instruct and encourage him to say the shahadah. (He whose last words are: (La ilaha illal-lah.) will enter Paradise.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: When tragedy strikes
duas.arabic: ((إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرَاً مِنْهَا)).
duas.translation: (To Allah we belong and unto Him is our return.O Allah, recompense me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Inna lillahi wa-inna ilayhi rajiAAoon, allahumma/- jurnee fee museebatee wakhluf lee khayran minha.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Invocation for closing the eyes of the dead
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِفُلاَنٍ (بِاسْمِهِ) وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ  يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, forgive -here the name of the deceased is mentioned- and raise his rank among the rightly guided, and be a successor to whom he has left behind, and forgive us and him O Lord of the worlds.  Make spacious his grave and illuminate it for him.)(A successor: one who succeeds another due to the latter’s absence or death. This is the correct meaning of the word khaleefah; thus, it is incorrect to believe that Adam is the khaleefah (vicegerent, as is commonly translated) of Allah on earth because Allah is never absent, and will never die.  This supplication proves the correct understanding of this term and shows that Allah succeeds us and guards whom we leave behind when we die or are absent (also refer to supplication #198).)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahummagh-fir li-name the dead- warfaAA darajatahu fil-mahdiyyeen, wakhlufhu fee AAaqibihi fil-ghabireen, waghfir lana walahu ya rabbal-AAalameen wafsah lahu fee qabrih, wanawwir lahu feeh.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: For the dead in the funeral prayer
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ، وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجَاً خَيْراً مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ [وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ])).
duas.translation: (O Allah, forgive and have mercy upon him, excuse him and pardon him, and make honourable his reception. Expand his entry, and cleanse him with water, snow, and ice, and purify him of sin as a white robe is purified of filth.  Exchange his home for a better home, and his family for a better family, and his spouse for a better spouse. Admit him into the Garden, protect him from the punishment of the grave and the torment of the Fire.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahummagh-fir lahu warhamh, waAAafihi, waAAfu AAanh, wa-akrim nuzulah, wawassiAA mudkhalah, waghsilhu bilma-i waththalji walbarad, wanaqqihi minal-khataya kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas, wa-abdilhu daran khayran min darih, wa-ahlan khayran min ahlih wazawjan khayran min zawjih, wa-adkhilhul-jannah, wa-aAAithhu min AAathabil-qabr, waAAathabin-nar)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: For the dead in the funeral prayer
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا. اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ، وَلاَ تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females.  O Allah, whom amongst us You keep alive, then let such a life be upon Islam, and whom amongst us You take unto Yourself, then let such a death be upon faith.  O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not let us stray after him.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahummagh-fir lihayyina wamayyitina washahidina, wagha-ibina, wasagheerina wakabeerina, wathakarina wa-onthana. Allahumma man ahyaytahu minna fa-ahyihi AAalal-islam, waman tawaffaytahu minna fatawaffahu AAalal-eeman, allahumma la tahrimna ajrah, wala tudillana baAAdah.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: For the dead in the funeral prayer
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ، وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ، فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ، وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ، فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحيمُ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, so-and-so is under Your care and protection so protect him from the trial of the grave and torment of the Fire.  Indeed You are faithful and truthful. Forgive and have mercy upon him, surely You are The Oft-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma inna -name the dead- fee thimmatik, wahabli jiwarik, faqihi min fitnatil-qabr waAAathabin-nar, wa-anta ahlul-wafa/, walhaq, faghfir lahu warhamh, innaka antal-ghafoorur-raheem.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: ইবন মাজাহ্‌, নং ১৪৯৯। দেখুন, সহীহ ইবন মাজাহ ১/২৫১ তাছাড়া হাদীসটি আবূ দাউদও বর্ণনা করেছেন, ৩/২১১, নং ৩২০২

duas.title: For the dead in the funeral prayer
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ احْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ، إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِناً فَزِدْ فِي حَسَنَاتِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئاً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, Your servant and the son of Your maidservant is in need of Your mercy and You are without need of his punishment. If he was righteous then increase his reward and if he was wicked then look over his sins.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma AAabduka wabnu amatik, ihtaja ila rahmatik, wa-anta ghaniyyun AAan AAathabih, in kana muhsinan fazid fee hasanatih, wa-in kana museean fatajawaz AAanh.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: হাদীসটি সংকলণ করেন, হাকেম তাঁর মুস্তাদরাকে এবং সহীহ বলেছেন, ১/৩৫৯; আর যাহাবী সেটা সমর্থন করেছেন। আরও দেখুন, আলবানী, আহকামুল জানায়েয, পৃ. ১২৫।

duas.title: Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ)) وإن قال: ((اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطاً وَذُخْراً لِوَالِدَيْهِ، وَشَفِيعاً مُجَاباً، اللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهِ مَوَازِينَهُمَا، وَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ أُجورَهُمَا، وَأَلْحِقْهُ بِصَالِحِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاجْعَلْهُ فِي كَفَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَقِهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأَسْلاَفِنَا، وَأَفْرَاطِنَا، وَمَنْ سَبَقَنَا بِالْإِيمَانِ)) إن قال ذلك فَحَسَنٌ.
duas.translation: O Allah, protect him from the torment of the grave . [it is also good to say] O Allah, make him a precursor, a forerunner and a treasure for his parents and an answered intercessor. O Allah, make him weigh heavily in their scales (of good)  and magnify their reward. Make him join the righteous of the believers. Place him in the care of Ibrahim. Save him by Your mercy from the torment of Hell. Give him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive those who have gone (i.e. passed away) before us, our children lost (by death), and those who have preceded us in Faith.
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allaahumma 'a'ith-hu min 'athaabil-qabri.) [or say:](Allahummaj-AAalhu faratan, wathukhran liwalidayh, washafeeAAan mujaban. Allahumma thaqqil bihi mawazeenahuma wa-aAAthim bihi ojoorahuma, wa-alhiqhu bisalihil-mu'mineen, wajAAalhu fee kafalati Ibraheem, waqihi birahmatika AAathabal-jaheem, wa 'abdilhu daaran khayran min daarihi, wa 'ahlan khayran min 'ahlihi, Allaahum-maghfir li'aslaafinaa, wa afraatinaa wa man sabaqanaa bil'eemaan)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا فَرَطاً، وَسَلَفاً، وَأَجْراً)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, make him for us a precursor,a forerunner and a cause of reward)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahummaj-AAalhu lana farata, wasalafan wa-ajra.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: হাসান বসরী রাহেমাহুল্লাহ যখন ছোট শিশুদের জানাযা পড়তেন তখন তার উপর সূরা ফাতেহা পড়তেন এবং উপরোক্ত দো‘আ বলতেন। হাদীসটি ইমাম বাগভী তার শারহুস সুন্নাহ ৫/৩৫৭ এ বর্ণনা করেছেন। আরও বর্ণনা করেছেন, আব্দুর রায্‌যাক তার মুসান্নাফে, নং ৬৫ ৮৮। তাছাড়া ইমাম বুখারী, কিতাবুল জানায়েয এর, ৬৫, বাবু কিরাআতি ফাতিহাতিল কিতাব আলাল জানাযাত ২/১১৩; ১৩৩৫ নং হাদীসের পূর্বে এটাকে তা‘লীক বা সনদ ব্যতীত বর্ণনা করেছেন।

duas.title: For the bereaved
duas.arabic: ((إِنَّ للَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمَّى... فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ)). وَإِنْ قَالَ: ((أَعْظَمَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ)) فَحَسَنٌ.
duas.translation: (Verily to Allah, belongs what He took and to Him belongs what He gave, and everything with Him has an appointed time…and then he  ordered for her to be patient and hope for Allah’s reward.)(The words (faltasbir waltahtasib) are commands in the feminine 3rd person form, so they will need to be changed in respect to whom is being addressed.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Inna lillahi ma akhath, walahu ma aAAta, wakullu shayin AAindahu bi-ajalin musamma…faltasbir waltahtasib.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Invocation to be recited when placing the dead in his grave
duas.arabic: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ)).
duas.translation: (In the name of Allah and upon the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Bismil-lahi waAAala sunnati rasoolil-lah.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: আবূ দাউদ ৩/৩১৪, নং ৩২১৫ সহীহ সনদে; অনুরূপভাবে আহমাদ, নং ৫২৩৪; আর ৪৮১২ এর শব্দ হচ্ছে, ‘বিসমিল্লাহ ওয়া আলা মিল্লাতি রাসূলিল্লাহ’ অর্থাৎ ‘আল্লাহর নামে এবং রাসূলুল্লাহর মিল্লাতের উপর।’ তার সনদও বিশুদ্ধ।

duas.title: Invocation to be recited after burying the dead
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ)).
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, strengthen him
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: Allaahum-maghfir lahu Allaahumma thabbithu
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: আবু দাউদ ৩/৩১৫, নং ৩২২৩; হাকেম এবং তিনি একে সহীহ বলেছেন, আর যাহাবী সমর্থন করেছেন, ১/৩৭০।

duas.title: Invocation for entering the restroom
duas.arabic: ([بِسْمِ اللَّهِ] اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبائِث).
duas.translation: ((In the name of Allah).  O Allah, I take refuge with you from all evil and evil-doers.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: ((Bismil-lah) allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba-ith.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Visiting the graves
duas.arabic: ((السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ، مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ، [وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَقدِمِينَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتأْخِرِينَ] أَسْاَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ)).
duas.translation: (Peace be upon you all, O inhabitants of the graves, amongst the believers and the Muslims. Verily we will, Allah willing, be united with you, we ask Allah for well-being for us and you.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Assalamu AAalaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu/mineena walmuslimeen, wa-inna in shaal-lahu bikum lahiqoon, nas-alul-laha lana walakumul-AAafiyah.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: মুসলিম ২/৬৭১, নং ৯৭৫; ইবন মাজাহ্‌, ১/৪৯৪, আর শব্দ তাঁরই, নং ১৫৪৭; বুরাইদা রাদিয়াল্লাহু ‘আনহু থেকে। আর দু ব্রাকেটের মাঝখানের অংশ আয়েশা রাদিয়াল্লাহু আনহার হাদীস থেকে, যা সংকলন করেছেন, মুসলিম, ২/৬৭১, নং ৯৭৫।

duas.title: Invocations for when the wind blows
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْــــــأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness and I take refuge with You from it’s evil.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Invocations for when the wind blows
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness, the good within it, and the good it was sent with, and I take refuge with You from it’s evil, the evil within it, and from the evil it was sent with.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma feeha, wakhayra ma orsilat bih, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha, washarri ma feeha washarri ma orsilat bih.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Invocation for when it thunder
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ)).
duas.translation: (How perfect He is, (The One) Whom the thunder declares His perfection with His praise, as do the angles out of fear of Him.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Subhanal-lathee yusabbihur-raAAdu bihamdih, walmala-ikatu min kheefatih.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: মুওয়াত্তা ইমাম মালেক ২/৯৯২ আর আলবানী তাঁর সহীহুল কালেমিত তাইয়্যেব গ্রন্থে পৃ. ১৫৭, বলেন, “এর সনদটি মওকূফ সহীহ”।

duas.title: For rain
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مُغِيثاً مَرِيئاً مَرِيعاً، نَافِعاً غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, send upon us helpful, wholesome and healthy rain, beneficial not harmful rain, now, not later.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahummas-qina ghaythan mugheethan maree-an mureeAAan, nafiAAan, ghayra dar, AAajilan ghayra ajil.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: আবূ দাউদ, ১/৩০৩, নং ১১৭১ আর শাইখ আলবানী সহীহ আবি দাউদে একে সহীহ বলেছেন, ১/২১৬।

duas.title: For rain
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma aghithna, allahumma aghithna, allahumma aghithna.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: For rain
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبَادَكَ، وَبَهَائِمَكَ، وَانْشُرْ رَحْمَتَكَ، وَأَحْيِي بَلَدَكَ الْمَيِّتَ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, provide water for Your servants and Your cattle, spread out Your mercy and resurrect Your dead land.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahummas-qi AAibadak, wabaha-imak, wanshur rahmatak, wa-ahyi baladakal-mayyit.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: আবূ দাউদ ১/৩০৫, নং ১১৭৮। আর শাইখ আলবানী তাঁর সহীহ আবি দাউদে একে হাসান বলেছেন, ১/২১৮।

duas.title: Invocation for when it rains
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّباً نَافِعاً)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain cloud.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma sayyiban nafiAAa.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Supplication after it rains
duas.arabic: ((مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ)).
duas.translation: (We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Mutirna bifadlil-lahi warahmatih.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: For the withholding of rain
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ، وَبُطُونِ الْأَوْدِيَةِ، وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, let the rain fall around us and not upon us, O Allah, (let it fall) on the pastures, hills, valleys and the roots of trees.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma hawalayna wala AAalayna, allahumma AAalal-akami waththirab, wabutoonil-awdiyah, wamanabitish-shajar.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: On sighting the new moon
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالْإِسْلاَمِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ)).
duas.translation: (Allah is the greatest. O Allah, let the crescent loom above us in safety, faith, peace, and Islam, and in agreement with all that You love and pleases You. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahu akbar, allahumma ahillahu AAalayna bil-amni wal-eeman, wassalamati wal-islam, wattawfeeiqi lima tuhibbu watarda, rabbuna warabbukal-lah.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: তিরমিযী ৫/৫০৪, নং ৩৪৫১; আদ-দারিমী, শব্দ তাঁরই, ১/৩৩৬। আরও দেখুন, সহীহুত তিরমিযী, ৩/১৫৭।

duas.title: Breaking the fast
duas.arabic: ((ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ العُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ)).
duas.translation: (The thirst has gone and the veins are quenched, and reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Thahabath-thama-o wabtallatil-AAurooq, wathabatal-ajru in shaal-lah.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: হাদীসটি সংকলন করেছেন আবূ দাউদ ২/৩০৬, নং ২৩৫৯ ও অন্যান্য। আরও দেখুন, সহীহুল জামে‘ ৪/২০৯।

duas.title: Breaking the fast
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which envelopes all things, that You forgive me.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma inne as-aluka birahmatikal-latee wasiAAat kulla shay, an taghfira lee.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: হাদীসটি সংকলন করেছেন, ইবন মাজাহ্‌ ১/৫৫৭, নং ১৭৫৩; যা মূলত আবদুল্লাহ ইবন আমর রাদিয়াল্লাহু আনহুমার দো‘আ। আর হাফেয ইবন হাজার তাঁর তাখরীজুল আযকারে এটার সনদকে হাসান বলেছেন। শরহুল আযকার, ৪/৩৪২

duas.title: Before eating
duas.arabic: ((إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَاماً فَلْيَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ بسمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ)).
duas.translation: (When you are about to eat, you should say:(Bismil-lah.)and if you forget to say it before starting, then you should say (when you remember):In the name of Allah in it’s beginning and end.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (When you are about to eat, you should say:(Bismil-lah.)and if you forget to say it before starting, then you should say (when you remember):Bismil-lahi fee awwalihi wa-akhirih.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Before eating
duas.arabic: ((مَنْ أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ الطَّعَامَ فَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ، وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ لَبَناً فَلْيَقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ)).
duas.translation: (Whomever Allah feeds, should say:(O Allah, bless it for us and feed us better than it.) and whomever Allah gives milk to drink should say:(O Allah, bless it for usand give us more of it.))
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Whomever Allah feeds, should say:(Allahumma barik lana feehi wa-atAAimna khayran minh.) and whomever Allah gives milk to drink should say:(Allahumma barik lana feehi wazidna minh.))
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Invocation for leaving the restroom
duas.arabic: (غُفْرَانَكَ).
duas.translation: (I ask You (Allah) for forgiveness.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Ghufranak.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: হাদীসটি নাসাঈ ব্যতীত সকল সুনান গ্রন্থকারই উদ্ধৃত করেছেন; তবে নাসাঈ তার ‘আমালুল ইয়াওমি ওয়াললাইলাহ’ গ্রন্থে (নং ৭৯) তা উদ্ধৃত করেছেন। আবূ দাউদ, নং ৩০; তিরমিযী, নং ৭; ইবন মাজাহ্‌, নং ৩০০। আর শাইখ আলবানী সহীহ সুনান আবি দাউদে ১/১৯ একে সহীহ বলেছেন।

duas.title: After eating
duas.arabic: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ، مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ)).
duas.translation: (All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might nor power from myself.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee atAAamanee hatha warazaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wala quwwah.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: হাদীসটি নাসাঈ ব্যতীত সকল সুনান গ্রন্থকারগণ সংকলন করেছেন। আবূ দাউদ, নং ৪০২৫; তিরমিযী, নং ৩৪৫৮; ইবন মাজাহ, নং ৩২৮৫। আরও দেখুন, সহীহুত তিরমিযী ৩/১৫৯।

duas.title: After eating
duas.arabic: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْداً كَثِيراً طَيِّباً مُبَارَكاً فِيهِ، غَيْرَ [مَكْفِيٍّ وَلاَ ] مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنَىً عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا)).
duas.translation: (Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise, a never-ending praise, a praise which we will never bid farewell to and an indispensable praise, He is our Lord.)(There are other views as regards to the understanding of this supplication, from them: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise. He is The One Who is sufficient, feeds and is not fed. The One Who is longed for, along with that which is with Him and The One Who is needed, He is our Lord.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Alhamdu lillahi hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh, ghayra makfiyyin wala muwaddaAAin, wala mustaghnan AAanhu rabbuna.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: A dinner guest's invocation for his host
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُم، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, bless for them, that which You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy upon them.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma barik lahum feema razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Invocation for someone who gives you drink or offers it to you
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي، وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, feed him who fed me, and provide with drink him who provided me with drink.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma atAAim man atAAamanee wasqi man saqanee.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Invocation for a family who invites you to break your fast with them
duas.arabic: ((أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ)).
duas.translation: (May the fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angles send prayers upon you.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Aftara AAindakumus-sa-imoon, wa-akala taAAamakumul-abrar, wasallat AAalaykumul-mala-ikah.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: সুনান আবি দাউদ ৩/৩৬৭, নং ৩৮৫৬; ইবন মাজাহ ১/৫৫৬, নং ১৭৪৭; নাসাঈ, আমালুল ইয়াওমি ওয়াল লাইলাহ, নং ২৯৬-২৯৮। আর সেখানে স্পষ্টভাবে বর্ণিত আছে যে রাসূলুল্লাহ সাল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম যখন তার পরিবারের কাছে ইফতার করতেন তখন তা বলতেন। আর শাইখ আলবানী তাঁর সহীহ আবি দাউদে একে সহীহ বলেছেন, ২/৭৩০।

duas.title: What to say when you are fasting and someone is rude to you
duas.arabic: ((إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ)).
duas.translation: (I am fasting, I am fasting.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Innee sa-im, innee sa-im.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Invocation for when you see the first dates of the season
duas.arabic: ((اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مُدِّنَا)).
duas.translation: (O Allah, bless our fruit for us, bless our town for us, bless our saAA for us and bless our mudd for us.)(A saAA is equivalent to four mudds and a mudd is equivalent to a dry measure of an average man’s two palms.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Allahumma barik lana fee thamarina, wabarik lana fee madeenatina, wabarik lana fee saAAina wabarik lana fee muddina.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Invocation for sneezing
duas.arabic: ((إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُم فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ: يَرحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَلْيَقُلْ: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ)).
duas.translation: (When one of you sneezes he should say:(All praise if for Allah.) and his brother or companion should say to him: (May Allah have mercy upon you.) and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him:(May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.))
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (When one of you sneezes he should say:(Alhamdu lillah.) and his brother or companion should say to him: (Yarhamukal-lah.) and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him:(Yahdeekumul-lahu wayuslihu balakum.))
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: What to say to the disbeliever if he sneezes and praises Allah
duas.arabic: ((يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ)).
duas.translation: (May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Yahdeekum wayuslihu balakum.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: For the groom
duas.arabic: ((بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ)).
duas.translation: (May Allah bless for you (your spouse) and bless you, and may He unite both of you in goodness.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Barakal-lahu lak, wabaraka AAalayk, wajamaAAa baynakuma fee khayr.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: হাদীসটি নাসাঈ ব্যতীত সকল সুনানগ্রন্থকারগণই সংকলন করেছেন। আবু দাঊদ, নং ২১৩০; তিরমিযী, নং ১০৯১; ইবন মাজাহ, নং ১৯০৫; নাসাঈ, আমালুল ইয়াওমি ওয়াল-লাইলাহ, নং ২৫৯। আরও দেখুন, সহীহুত তিরমিযী ১/৩১৬।

duas.title: What to say before performing ablution
duas.arabic: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ).
duas.translation: (In the name of Allah.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Bismil-lah.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: তিরমিযী ২/৫০৫, নং ৬০৬, ও অন্যান্য। আরও দেখুন, ইরওয়াউল গালীল, নং ৫০; সহীহুল জামে‘ ৩/২০৩

duas.title: Wedding night
duas.arabic: إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ أَحَدُكُمُ امْرَأَةً، أَوْ إِذَا اشْتَرَى خَادِماً فَلْيَقُلْ: ((اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى بَعِيراً فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِذِرْوَةِ سَنَامِهِ وَلْيَقُلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ)).
duas.translation: (when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say:(O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that you have made her inclined towards, and I take refuge with You from the evil within her and the evil that you have made her inclined towards.))(and if you buy a camel, then you should take hold of it’s hump and say likewise.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma jabaltaha AAalayh, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha washarri ma jabaltaha AAalayh.))(and if you buy a camel, then you should take hold of it’s hump and say likewise.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: Before intimacy
duas.arabic: ((بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا)).
duas.translation: (In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what you have blessed us with.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Bismil-lah, allahumma jannibnash-shaytan, wajannibish-shaytana ma razaqtana.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: বুখা্রী (৪-কিতাবুল ওয়াদূ, ৮-বাবুত তাসমিয়াতি..) ১/৬৫ (ভারতীয় ২/৭৭৬); মুসলিম (১৬-কিতাবুন নিকাহ, ১৮-বাব মা ইউসতাহাব্বু আন ইয়াকূলাহু) ২/১০৫৮ (ভারতীয় ১/৪৬৩)।

duas.title: For anger
duas.arabic: ((أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ)).
duas.translation: (I take refuge with Allah from the accursed devil.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (aAAoothu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: On seeing someone afflicted by misfortune
duas.arabic: ((الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً)).
duas.translation: (All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He tested you with and Who most certainly favoured me over much of His creation.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee AAafanee mimmab-talaka bih, wafaddalanee AAala katheerin mimman khalaqa tafdeela.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: What to say while sitting in an assembly
duas.arabic: ((عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه قَاَلَ: كَانَ يُعَدُّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْمَجْلِسِ الوَاحِدِ مِائَةُ مَرَّةٍ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ يَقُومَ: ((رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الغَفُورُ)).
duas.translation: (Ibn AAumar  said: It would be counted that the Messenger of Allah  would say one hundred times at any one sitting before getting up: (O my Lord, forgive me and turn towards me (to accept my repentance). Verily You are The Oft-Returning. The Oft-Forgiving.))
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Ibn AAumar  said: It would be counted that the Messenger of Allah  would say one hundred times at any one sitting before getting up: (Rabbigh-fir lee watub AAalay, innaka antat-tawwabul-ghafoor.))
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani

duas.title: The Expiation of Assembly - Kaffaratul-Majlis
duas.arabic: ((سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ)).
duas.translation: (How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You.  I bear witness that None has the right to be worshipped except You.  I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdik, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: নাসাঈ, আমালুল ইয়াওমি ওয়াল লাইলাহ, পৃ. ১৭৩ আরও দেখুন, ইরওয়াউল গালীল, ১/১৩৫, ৩/৯৪

duas.title: When someone says 'may Allah forgive you'
duas.translation: (AAabdullah Ibn Sarjis  said: ‘I went to see the Prophet  and ate from his food and then said to him: (May Allah forgive you, O Messenger of Allah.) he  replied: (and you.))
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (AAabdullah Ibn Sarjis  said: ‘I went to see the Prophet  and ate from his food and then said to him:(Ghafaral-lahu laka ya rasoolal-lah.) he  replied: (wa-lak))
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: আহমাদ ৫/৮২, নং ২০৭৭৮; আন-নাসাঈ, আমালুল ইয়াওমি ওয়াল লাইলাহ, পৃ. ২১৮, নং ৪২১ তাহকীক, ড. ফারূক হাম্মাদাহ।

duas.title: For someone who does good to you
duas.arabic: ((جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً)).
duas.translation: (If someone does you a favour and you say: (May Allah reward you with goodness.) then you have indeed excelled in praising him.)
duas.translation_attribution: Hisn al-Muslim English text via github.com/wafaaelmaandy/Hisn-Muslim-Json (NO LICENSE DECLARED - redistribution not permitted, see LICENSES.md)
duas.upstream_note: (If someone does you a favour and you say: (Jazakal-lahu khayran.) then you have indeed excelled in praising him.)
duas.source_author: Sa'id ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani
duas.hadith_reference: তিরমিযী, হাদিস নং ২০৩৫। আরও দেখুন, সহীহুল জামে‘ ৬২৪৪; সহীহুত তিরমিযী, ২/২০০।

duas.title: Protection from fitnah
duas.arabic: ((مَنْ حَفِظَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ عُصِمَ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ)) ، وَالْاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَتِهِ عَقِبَ التَّشَهُّدِ الْأَخِيرِ مِنْ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ.
